rule.name: Thin Air
rule.description: Every deck's air is rationed. Your suit tank drains each turn; each new deck's scrubbers top it up a little.

effects.text: The deck scrubbers hiss. Your tank gauge climbs.
Find moss. Find a canister. Find anything.

rule.name: Two Hundred Years of Wear
rule.description: Everything aboard is older than your grandparents. Tools and plating wear out with use, and the running lights are dimmed to save power.

rule.name: MATRON Is Listening
rule.description: The ship talks to you. Every so often it says your name, loudly, and things in the dark turn to look.

effects.text: MATRON: 'Ines. You are out of your bunk. Please return to your bunk.'

rule.name: Small Town, Long Memory
rule.description: Every time you leave someone speechless, the group chat hears about it. Lowmoor keeps score.

effects.text: Without your phone, the hallways feel twice as long.

rule.name: The Water's Coming
rule.description: The reservoir is already seeping up through the floors. Every day, and every so often, a little more of Lowmoor goes wet.

effects.text: There is water on the floor again. Nobody mentions it.

rule.name: Three Strikes
rule.description: Hall monitors are writing people up for anything. Collect three detention slips and you are sent home for the week, and the week is all there is.

rule.name: Endless Drizzle
rule.description: It will not stop raining. Everyone moves a little slower.
